limits: All prior frozen bytes, failures, quarantine and protections remain unchanged; every live gate CLOSED.

No native frame/crash-file provider, CM_BLAME/CM_CRASHES/startup/quarantine operation, callback nesting/concurrency, DSO/installer, signal/nonlocal exit, firmware/emulator/device, production/live composition or release.

matrix.assertions: No semantic assertion count is claimed before implementation. Every process checks unchanged authored inputs and no infrastructure error. Ordinary selectors check their own complete expected projection. Each dedicated baseline/control checks one named owning composite; no generic full-output or duplicate cross-composite invariant shadows its changed fields.
matrix.control_acceptance: For each mode, first exact baseline candidate passes, then one macro variant on same selector fails exactly its named composite with all shared truthful facts passing. Different controls never compose. Nonzero exit without exact failed-name set, unexpected diagnostic, malformed output or additional failure is refused.
matrix.control_builds: Candidate and five named single-macro variants per mode; reject multiple control macros. Compile new classifier/case accessor as separate translation units with private accessor noinline/noclone and no LTO. Harness/case data remain identical across control variants. Exact build commands and codegen method review must be frozen/reviewed before first later build.
matrix.environment: Later separately authorized offline Linux AArch64 ordinary host only, using existing pinned toolchain/image; no disposable native file or forked I/O witness required. Each selector starts a fresh process; counter begins zero and is never reset.

canonical_outputs.InvalidChildEvidence: Valid accepted header with malformed child returns InvalidChildEvidence; child zero/unavailable; consumptions1; parent_facts_available=true with valid header facts copied. A local InvalidEvidence tuple is not exposed as an available child.
canonical_outputs.InvalidHeader: status InvalidHeader; child_available=false; child zero; consumptions0; parent_facts_available=false and every copied parent/policy/frozen field zero. Invalid uint32 marker/tag never creates invalid C bool storage.
canonical_outputs.InvalidSlot: Validate header first, then slot range. Valid header with invalid slot returns InvalidSlot; child zero/unavailable; consumptions0; parent_facts_available=false and all copied fields zero.
canonical_outputs.ValidAvailable: status Valid; child_available=true; exact local semantic tuple; consumptions1; parent_facts_available=true with exact valid header facts copied.
canonical_outputs.ValidUnavailable: status Valid; child_available=false; child storage all-zero/Unavailable; consumptions0; parent_facts_available=true with exact authored parent_observe/unlink/remove, policy_verdict and frozen_hold_basis copied.

parent_projection.child_validation: Validate/classify only the accessed record. Malformed accepted payload returns InvalidChildEvidence, no child outcome, exactly one logical consumption. This value model does not parse actual wire reports or accept stopped snapshots from the frozen witness.
parent_projection.distinct_acceptance: shape_size_read_ok/bindings_ok correspond only to structural facts. Provenance/conversions/setup remain separate gate conditions. policy_verdict is copied but excluded; truthful failed policy controls remain eligible evidence. Parent operation acknowledgments and frozen held basis are copied independently and never change child classification or helper/native acknowledgments.
parent_projection.domains: version1; every gate term uint32 in{0,1}; verdict0=Unchecked/1=Pass/2=Fail; frozen_hold_basis0/1; each parent ack0=Unavailable/1=ReturnedZero/2=ReturnedError. All well-typed predicate vectors are allowed, including one false with other terms true; these are authored conditions, not a reconstruction of a real execution chronology.
parent_projection.entry: Parent entry accepts only header by value and bounded slot index. It must not receive, copy, validate, classify or hash a child payload aggregate before the gate. Local route is separate and must not decode that same child as a pre-gate convenience.
parent_projection.frozen_hold_basis: 0/1 use the same HeldUnvalidated/VerifiedHeld historical labels as local basis, never current custody. This header value is independently copied and cannot decide the child result; this plan does not authenticate arbitrary cross-record histories. The stale-held selector uses matching starting basis1 in both header and child with child current custodyClosedReturned.
parent_projection.gate: After header scalar domains and slot range safety only, one conjunction of all nine terms decides evidence use. False returns canonical Valid/Unavailable with zero logical payload consumptions, including when hidden child values are contradictory. No false provenance input is an input-domain error.
parent_projection.limits: Logical accessor consumption is a source-level ordinary-call observation, not proof of no compiler aggregate move, speculative CPU read, data race, native visibility or interrupt-safe snapshot. Private tables/counter are fixture-only; no general concurrent reader protocol.
parent_projection.reader: Only after the gate call one private noninline fixed-table accessor. It increments a process-local unsigned logical-read counter exactly once and copies the selected local record by value. The accessor only enforces bounded index/storage safety, never repeats evidence acceptance. No callback, runtime pointer argument or external provider is introduced.
parent_projection.slot_table: One immutable local-record slot for every candidate selector in listed order, followed by no extra hidden slot. Dedicated baseline/control uses the same slot. Invalid-slot selector passes table length. Fixed private storage initialized before entry; no publication/write/reuse protocol is claimed.

No callbacks or pointer input are needed.
shared_oracle_partition.malformed: Controls use valid input rows and do not disable domain/stage input checks. Malformed separate ordinary selectors stay refused; hidden malformed payload under false gate is never consumed and returns Unavailable, not InvalidChildEvidence.

value_schema.captured_branch_mapping: After the sole captured-result branch, native outcome is Zero when raw0 and Error when raw-1. For each outcome, stage7 selects HelperReturnedZero/Error, stage6 selects DispositionZero/Error, and every other stage selects CapturedZero/Error. Input validation makes the other-stage arm stage5 in candidates; C1 deliberately admits stage3 and therefore deterministically yields CapturedZero. Helper acknowledgement still copies the already validated helper_returned marker. No later captured/stage veto.
value_schema.consistency: Every stage-table input relation is conjunctive validation; the derived eligibility column is excluded from input validation and output repair. Basis1 requires held custody1 where table says held; basis0 requires0. Captured-before-promotion accepts UnknownPre even with raw0/-1. HelperReturned is an authored caller-observed fact, never a helper self-ack.
value_schema.error_scope: 4 and5 are authored EINTR/EIO-labelled sentinels, never actual errno capture or an exhaustive native errno domain. Other complete errors are InvalidEvidence in this finite prototype.
value_schema.forbidden: No descriptor, address, callback, function pointer, syscall dispatcher, provider adapter, native memory reader, whole engine or live capability.
value_schema.invalid: Any unknown tag/version/label/marker, unsupported tuple, or stage/flag/custody contradiction returns canonical InvalidEvidence with no outcome/eligibility/ack. Partial tuples remain nonauthoritative and are not treated as contradictory complete receipts.
local_algorithm_contract: Validate input domains and exact stage relation first.
One captured==1 classification branch selects native Zero/Error; C1 changes this branch only. No later phase check may silently repair that control.
Without capture classify HeldFresh, NonDispatch, UnknownBeforeLeaf, EnteredWithoutCapture or PartialCapture from the validated stage.
Only HeldFresh has historical eligibility true. Omission has consumed its one request and remains false despite held obligation.

After complete error, use captured_branch_mapping for the exact stage-specific Error tuple with false eligibility. C2 replaces only the stage7 error tuple; no later independent request-used veto masks it.
Keep helper-return acknowledgment separate: true only for valid omission or stage7. No inferred syscall dispatch, no native cleanup action.

value_schema.output: Status, exact classification, native_outcome(Unavailable/Zero/Error), inert historical_eligibility, helper_return_ack; no resource-operation permission. Input label/basis and copied raw/error evidence remain separate unchanged data.

result_layout.canonical_zero: All result tag/marker storage initialized to zero, then exact status/fields assigned. JSON child:null denotes zeroed child value storage with no child availability, not a pointer field.
result_layout.local: Exactly status, classification, native_outcome, historical_eligibility, helper_return_ack. No pointer or capability member. Valid semantic tuples are listed per selector. InvalidEvidence zeros every semantic field; status distinguishes refusal.
